facts.fact: Groom Haüs's 'Marketing Unleashed' page is dated August 7, 2025.
Groom Haüs describes its pricing playlist as a guide to the business side of pet grooming, aimed at groomers.
facts.quote: Welcome to Groom Haüs’ pricing playlist, your go-to guide for mastering the business side of pet grooming.

facts.fact: The Groom Haüs pricing series says it covers structuring prices, pricing models, communicating value to clients, and raising prices.
facts.quote: explore different pricing models, communicate value to your clients, and raise your prices with professionalism
